subject: Vendr: Lite onboarding — evidence gap walkthrough and timeline
messages:
From: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@nimblefin.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NimbleFin Security <security@nimblefin.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr: starting a lightweight evidence sync for SOC2 / SIG

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for agreeing to run a minimal onboarding via Vendr — NimbleFin would like to get a slim evidence bundle uploaded this week so our procurement team can close the PO. We're aiming for SOC 2 scope only (no full CAIQ yet).

Quick ask: can you share a short checklist of the minimum artifacts you need (sysadmin attestations, encryption KMS proof, policy pointers, and any sample logs) and an ETA for getting the Vendr invite live? Our security ops team (cc'd) will upload the initial CSV of Q&A responses but want to avoid chasing missing documents.

Also, do you support compressed proof bundles (signed manifests) or do you prefer individual file uploads into the portal?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20m call if that's easier.

Best,
Sofia Chen
Head of Vendor Risk, NimbleFin
sofia.chen@nimblefin.com

---
ATTACHMENTS: none (they said they'd upload the CSV once we confirm scope)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Chen <sofia.chen@nimblefin.com>
Cc: NimbleFin Security <security@nimblefin.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Feb 2028 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr: starting a lightweight evidence sync for SOC2 / SIG

Hi Sofia — thanks, happy to coordinate.

Quick answers up front:
- Vendr invite: sending now (you should see an invite link in a separate message).
- Preferred upload: individual files in the portal are easiest for our QA; we can accept a compressed bundle if you include a signed manifest (hash list).
- Minimal evidence checklist (attached PDF):
  1) SOC 2 summary / audit letter (last 12 months) or SOC 2 scope and control matrix
  2) KMS / key rotation policy and last rotation evidence (kms-rotation.log or statement)
  3) Example access review (screenshot or exported CSV)
  4) Sample system logs (7 days, redacted) and log-retention policy
  5) Change management ticket or PR showing privileged deploy approval
  6) Encryption-in-transit proof (TLS cert chain)
  7) Minimal network diagram (PNG)

I've attached a short one-pager (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) that maps the items above to the SIG questions most commonly asked during a lightweight intake. If you want us to pre-populate the Vendr Q&A where possible, we can do that once the invite is accepted.

Proposed timeline:
- Thu Feb 9: invite + checklist (today)
- Fri Feb 10: NimbleFin uploads initial Q&A CSV and any immediately available docs
- Mon Feb 13: Redwood completes initial pass and flags gaps
- Wed Feb 15: gap remediation call (if needed)

If the PO needs to close sooner, let me know and Naomi (cc) can prioritize a tighter turnaround.

Aisha Rahman
Sr. Sales Ops (Security liaison) | Redwood Inference
---
ATTACHMENTS: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (6 pages)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Marcus / Aisha — looping in a short internal note so we have clear owners for the artifacts Sofia will upload. Copying the external thread for context.

Owner assignments (proposed):
- SOC 2 summary / audit letter: Naomi (I'll attach the latest summary and map to SIG)
- KMS proof and key rotation logs: Marcus (you have the rotation logs and policy)
- Access review export: Aisha to coordinate with Support team to pull the report
- Logs / retention: Marcus to provide redacted logs and retention doc
- Network diagram / TLS chain: Aisha to pull from infra kit

Action items: please confirm by EOD Fri Feb 10. I'll prepare a short upload manifest so we can call out filenames we expect in the Vendr portal to avoid back-and-forth.

Thanks — Naomi
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
